map.计算样本/总体标准差、方差、变异系数（CV）。: Computes the sample or population standard deviation, variance and coefficient of variation (CV).
map.📖 查看「标准差与方差使用指南」: 📖 View the "Standard Deviation and Variance User Guide"
map.方差 s² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1 或 n)；标准差 s: Variance s² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1 or n); standard deviation s = √s²; CV = s / |x̄| × 100%
map.先求均值 x̄，再算各值离差平方和，除以自由度即得方差：样本用 n − 1（无偏: Compute the mean x̄ first, then the sum of squared deviations, and divide by the degrees of freedom to get the variance: a sample uses n − 1 (unbiased) and a population uses n. The standard deviation is the square root of the variance and shares the units of the original data; the coefficient of variation divides the standard deviation by the absolute mean as a percentage, allowing comparison across units. Here n is fixed at 7, so samples use a denominator of 6 and populations a denominator of 7.
map.方差 s² = Σ(x − x̄)² / (n − 1)（样本）或 n（总体）: Variance s² = Σ(x − x̄)² / (n − 1) (sample) or n (population)
map.类型填 1 为样本标准差，填 2 为总体标准差。: Enter 1 for the sample standard deviation and 2 for the population standard deviation.
map.检验数据是否近似正态（Shapiro/K-S 思路）。: Tests whether the data are approximately normal (Shapiro-Wilk / Kolmogorov-Smirnov approach).
map.参数检验前提验证。: Verifies the assumptions behind parametric tests.
map.非正态时改用非参方法。: Switch to nonparametric methods when the data are not normal.
map.偏度峰度判正态: Judging normality by skewness and kurtosis
map.≈0、超额峰度≈0、且 QQ plot 近似直线 → 可视为正态，可用 t 检验: with values near 0 and excess kurtosis near 0, plus a roughly straight QQ plot, the data can be treated as normal so a t-test is appropriate.
map.偏度 1.5、峰度 4 → 非正态，宜用 Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitn: Skewness of 1.5 and kurtosis of 4 point to non-normality, so nonparametric tests such as Wilcoxon or Mann-Whitney are preferable.
map.正态性检验 p>0.05 就正态？: Does p>0.05 in a normality test mean the data are normal?
map.不，只是\"未检出偏离\"，大样本即使轻微偏离也显著、小样本则不敏感，需结合图判: No. It only means no departure was detected: large samples flag even slight departures while small samples are insensitive, so judge alongside plots.
map.非正态必须换方法？: Must you change methods if the data are not normal?
map.大样本下许多检验对偏离稳健（CLT），或做变换（log/Box-Cox）后用参数: Many tests tolerate departures in large samples thanks to the CLT; alternatively transform the data (log / Box-Cox) and use a parametric method.
